notes.title: PATCH: v0.1.1.7 Beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/9348f9c6657cf1bae794eb5d6d4fd03ccf330e9f.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Scene Editor (Early Preview)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/90ebf0e8017952f49de2ffb0321db6486966f4ba.jpg[/img]
A lot of you have been asking for a more custom lighting system for VJing so we have created the Scene Editor! 

The Scene Editor allows you to change attributes within lighting fixtures such as Color, Rotation, and more on a 60 second timeline that includes 30 keyframes to edit. With the Early Preview, you get the access to create up to 11 different scenes that can be controlled via TouchOSC and MIDI. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Steam: Invite & Join Friends[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/a7fde187b860b84879368106c5d238263156c51a.png[/img]
It has taken a while to implement but you can now invite and join your friends sessions without getting kicked to the main menu. Simply open the Steam Overlay or visit the Friends section on Steam. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]LAN Stream Support[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/590a8fe0b96ad68d4e0277d1cd27bdf8efbfddcf.jpg[/img]
Have you ever worked on a visual layout and wanted to test it before streaming live? Or maybe you just want to make a recording without going live for everyone?

Well you can now connect OBS through your local network and stream directly into R.A.V.E! ([url=https://docs.ravegameofficial.com/video-setup-lan.html]More Info[/url])
(Local access only, does not work over multiplayer)

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Owncast Livestream Support[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/0135febae75044d28b802c5f5b11e57e886cc53b.png[/img]
"Owncast" livestreams are now supported through the Host Event menu. Owncast is a free and open source live video and web chat server for use with existing popular broadcasting software.([url=https://owncast.online/]More Info[/url])

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Venue Builder: Fireworks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/e80a1c7aa62c1d2e704d22de306f4bb7d4f314a0.jpg[/img]
It's time for a celebration. So grab your fireworks and light up the night!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]FULL UPDATE LOG:[/h2]

[b]Steam:[/b]
- Inviting and joining friends sessions is now functional through the Steam Overlay.

[b]Media Player:[/b]
- Added local only Video Streaming through LAN. (Read the docs for more info: https://docs.ravegameofficial.com/video-setup-lan.html)
- Added support for "Owncast" servers. (https://owncast.online/)
- Fixed "Stream Title" in Pause Menu to show correct name or URL of the current stream. 

[b]VJ Lighting:[/b]
- "Tube Light" strobe speed now reacts to commands. 
- Updated backend for commands. 

[b]Venue Builder:[/b]
- Added "Scene Editor" system (Early Preview).
- Added "Fireworks".
- Fog Machine: Increased object limit to 20. 
- Fire Cannon: Increased object limit to 20. 
- Changed UI Controls background to grey.

[b]Character Creator:[/b]
- Backend improvements for the loading of items. 

[b]Default Character:[/b]

[b]Venue - The Black Box:[/b]
- Added small edits to the level.
- Performance optimizations. 

[b]Venue - Entercity Loft:[/b]
- Performance optimizations.

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
- Adjusted menu sizes to be more acceptable on multiple resolutions and aspect ratios. 
- Decreased startup time by 3 seconds.

notes.title: PATCH: v0.1.1.1 Beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/0753a9e5b5cccdd921553c5572799970c6efa024.png[/img]

[h3]We have listened to your feedback for the past month and have been hard at work on improving many features![/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[u][h1]Major VR Improvements[/h1][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756294/68087a3b6c4f318c60aeb4bc5642f0a719a64375.png[/img]

[h2]Automatic Calibration:[/h2]
Body and arms automatically calibrate their rotations on the start of each level. Manual calibration has been removed. 

[h2]Legacy Controls:[/h2]
If using Meta Link / Air Link, Enable Legacy Controls to fix the wrist positions/rotations. Newer apps (Steam Link) use the default of OpenXRs controller positions while Meta Link uses the native OpenVR positions. 

[h2]Seated Mode - Snap Turn:[/h2]
Switch from Smooth Turning to Snap Turning if you're in Seated Mode. Best used for low network settings and to prevent simulation sickness.  

[h2]Hand Size:[/h2]
Adjust the size of your hands to match better with your IRL hands. Increase or decrease up to 20%. 

[h2]Standing, Seated, Roomscale:[/h2]
Now supporting all movement types with improved navigation and collision. 

Find all of these options in the [b]Main Menu > Options > Controls[/b].

[hr][/hr]

notes.content:
Todays hotfix consists of more fixes to achievements as well as fixes for VR. 

If you play in VR and are having issues with the controls, menus, etc; Please reach out and contact us through our website, email, Discord, or fill out the Early Access Survey with as much detail as possible. 

[b]WMR COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
We understand that users who use WMR compatible headsets may be experiencing issues with launching. Windows Mixed Reality has been considered deprecated by Microsoft and will be discontinued by 2026. We recommend upgrading your headset by then. However, we are still investigating this issue because other WMR games still work at this time. We also don't own one of these headsets or have access to one so a fix for this may take a lot longer than expected. We're sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: HOTFIX: v0.1.1.0.1 Beta
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

We hope you're enjoying R.A.V.E in the first few days of the big release! 

There's been a couple major bugs that are causing havoc and we called the exterminator to get rid of them for you! Make sure you let us know if you find anymore!

Thank you to everyone who has been sending us feedback and reviews in order for us to tackle these issues as soon as we can. Since we're a very small team and this is our first game, it may take us longer for certain features or fixes. We aren't a high-class AAA game company with a huge budget, we are simple people who work regular jobs and spend our money and time on this out of our own pockets because we love it. So bare with us while we develop this massive game and please reach out to us in anyway possible if you need help or find issues. 

Discord: https://discord.com/servers/r-a-v-e-community-732114766352351232
